capabilities: Stage01 project conditions are the first required declaration step.
Stage01 permits initialization of RVTs that already contain model elements.
Stage02 performs deterministic full-model or current-selection preparation.
Stage03 performs live Stage01 and Stage02 evidence reconstruction before export.
Stage03 defaults to strict mode and supports explicitly reasoned forced-test mode.
Autodesk IFC4 RAW is exported without in-place mutation and is protected by SHA-256.
H-IFC is published only after candidate disk reread and exact Entity, Owner, Pset, Property, IFC type and value validation.
IFCFlux has no API; external status remains IFCFLUX_MANUAL_PENDING until user inspection.
Manual Revit UI and MCP use the same Stage01, Stage02 and Stage03 services.
The MCP surface contains 13 approved business tools and exposes no arbitrary Revit API execution.
